content: Does it pass you by? Do not stop it. Is it not yet come? Do not stretch your desire towards it, but wait till it reaches you.
author: Epictetus
story:
Born into slavery in Hierapolis and physically crippled by a brutal master in imperial Rome, Epictetus acquired his freedom after Nero's death and founded a renowned philosophical academy in Nicopolis. Having experienced genuine subjugation, he founded his philosophy on the inviolable inner freedom of the human will: chains may bind the body, but no tyrant can conquer the faculty of choice.

In formulating this reflection, Epictetus stripped away superficial conventions to address the core anatomy of patience. For Epictetus, true wisdom is never an abstract luxury, but an urgent practical discipline required to navigate life with clarity and unshakeable dignity.
reflectionPrompt: Where in your current routine are you choosing convenient illusion over uncomfortable truth?
